shortDescription: GitHub-style user profile overview view with repository highlights and activity.
fullDescription: Main user profile overview view for the default state. It renders a dark GitHub-style profile page with a top product header, profile sidebar, tab navigation, a popular repositories grid, yearly contribution heatmap, and contribution activity heading. The view supports configurable profile data, repository cards, selected tab, selected year, and contribution fixtures while keeping visible tabs, year filters, buttons, and search input interactive through local or controlled state.
